_doc: Industry definitions. A business type lists the fixtures it uses, the product categories it may sell, staff roles, hours and its upgrade tree. Only types with playable=true can be opened; the others are planned on the same architecture.

supermarket.name: Mini Supermarket
supermarket.planned: Bigger premises, trolleys, aisles, self-checkout. Same stock and staff systems.

takeaway.name: Takeaway
takeaway.planned: Cook-to-order menu from raw ingredients, delivery riders.

car_wash.name: Car Wash
car_wash.planned: Bays, queue of vehicles from traffic, wash stations.

warehouse.name: Warehouse
warehouse.planned: Bulk storage, cheaper pallet buying, auto-supply shops with vans.

floor.name: New Flooring
floor.desc: Clean modern floor. Gets dirty 30% slower, +6% conversion.

coffee.name: Coffee Machine
coffee.desc: Sell fresh coffee (made in store, big margin).

pick_mix.name: Pick & Mix Wall
pick_mix.desc: Customers fill their own sweet bags.

security.name: CCTV
security.desc: Shoplifting drops from 3% to 0.5% of shelf stock walking out.
